headline: Frontlines Flare as Bases Trade Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the 06:11 edition the most volatile fronts have deepened their churn. Weathered Expanse now records 36 ownership changes in the last 24 hours — up from 34 — with Colonial casualties climbing to 178,938 and Warden casualties to 196,855, both casualty rates and enlistments accelerating. Stonecradle has risen to 17 flips, centred on World’s End, The Reach and Buckler Sound, pushing totals to 61,346 Colonial and 78,156 Warden dead. Fishermans Row, quiet in the prior report, has surged to 14 flips across Black Well, Dankana Post, Arcadia and Eidolo, bringing its toll to 11,557 Colonial and 13,891 Warden. Mooring County remains a flashpoint with nine flips in the day and a 24‑hour cost of 23,600 Colonial and 19,268 Warden, though no new flips occurred in the last two hours. Farranac Coast holds steady at nine flips, losses at 47,944 Colonial and 59,379 Warden. Linn Mercy’s activity has eased to six flips around Lathair, totals 54,708 Colonial and 69,092 Warden. Gutter reports five new flips at The Parras, while Stlican Shelf logged a single Colonial capture at Thornhold. Northern Warden‑held sectors and rear areas show no ownership changes.
